& Overtime

1× COMPENSATION

1.5× COMPENSATION

2× COMPENSATION

Attendance

is a shared

commitment.

Regular attendance is required. If you will be absent, notify your manager as soon as possible. Repeated lateness may lead to salary deductions under company policy.

BY 9:00

No deduction

9:01 Considered late

9:01 - 10:00

Half-day leave deduction on repeated lateness

AFTER 10:00

Full-day leave deduction

DIGITEC DISTRIBUTION / EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

14

Plan leave early.

Keep teams moving.

Leave is granted under Egyptian Labor Law and company policy. Manager approval is required before HR processing.

1 WEEK AHEAD

Requests longer than one day.

2 WEEKS AHEAD

Summer vacations, holiday bridges or 5+ consecutive days.

SICK LEAVE

Notify promptly and provide medical documentation.

TEAM COVERAGE No more than 50% of a team may be on leave simultaneously without management approval.

WORKPLACE CONDUCT

Respect is non-negotiable.

Professionalism, respect, integrity and honesty guide every interaction. Protect confidentiality, company property and avoid conflicts of interest.

Harassment

Discrimination

Bullying

Threats or violence

Report inappropriate behavior to HR. Every report is handled confidentially and promptly.

16

Fair opportunity.

Secure workplace.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Employment decisions are based on qualifications, performance and business needs.

INFORMATION SECURITY

Protect customer and company data, passwords and confidential documents. Unauthorized disclosure may lead to disciplinary action.

COMPANY PROPERTY

Safeguard laptops, phones, access cards, keys and equipment - and return all property upon separation.
